question.text: A Cat III AIF must determine NAV on every Business Day in which:

answer.text: The fund deals/executes trades (for MTM at close of last securities market)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 265, NAV should be calculated at the close of business of the last securities market on every Business Day in which the fund deals or executes trades, for mark-to-market purposes. The Trap: Valuer presence, investor redemptions, and Trustee availability are not the workbook-defined triggers for NAV computation. Note: Hold to the source Valuation Day rule on page 265 — NAV at close of business of the last securities market on every Business Day the fund deals or executes trades.
